title: Accounts
subtitle: Manage who can sign in and what they can do.
forbidden: Admin role required to manage accounts.
createHint: Username required. Give a password (≥8 chars) OR an email to send a setup link.
passwordLinkPlaceholder: leave blank to email a link
sendLinkHint: Email a one-time password setup/reset link to this account.
emailHint: Used for password setup/reset links. Leave blank to clear.
pageAccessHint: Off = every page (the default). On = only the checked pages; all others are hidden and blocked at the API. Dashboard and Agents stay visible to everyone.
pageAccessSelfLock: You can't remove your own access to Accounts.

group.title: Permission groups
group.subtitle: Reusable page allow-lists. Assign an account to a group and the group governs its page access — edit the group to update every member at once.
group.name: Name
group.editHint: The pages this group grants. Members see exactly these (plus the always-open commons: Dashboard and Agents).
group.selfLockWarn: This group doesn't grant the Accounts page. Assigning it to your own account would lock you out of account management — choose a group that includes Accounts, or add Accounts to this group first.
